children: ENQUEST PLC: REMAINS ON TRACK TO DELIVER PRODUCTION WITHIN GUIDANCE RANGE SET AT START OF YEAR
ENQUEST PLC:   FIRST HALF PRODUCTION ROSE 9% YEAR-ON-YEAR, AVERAGING 41,544 BOEPD
ENQUEST PLC: FOLLOWING MAGNUS OPERATIONAL INTERRUPTION, GROUP IS TIGHTENING PRODUCTION GUIDANCE TO 41 TO 43 KBOED FOR FY
ENQUEST PLC:   ENQUEST NET DEBT AT 30 JUNE 2026 TOTALLED $517.0 MILLION
ENQUEST PLC: FOR PERIOD SEPTEMBER TO DECEMBER 2026, GROUP HAS C.2.2 MMBBLS OF PRODUCTION HEDGED.
ENQUEST: FOR 2027, ENQUEST HAS FURTHER C.3.6 MMBBLS OF PRODUCTION HEDGED UTILISING SWAPS AT AVERAGE PRICE OF $64.4/BBL AND IN 2028
ENQUEST PLC: FULL YEAR ASSET EXPENDITURE IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN UNCHANGED FROM GROUP'S ORIGINAL GUIDANCE OF $670 MILLION
